sourceBinding.notes: Field policy is derived from checked domain config and source binding surfaces.

universalDomainFields.reason: Every domain needs stable identity and versioned readback binding.
universalDomainFields.safeNextAction: keep identity fields in the core domain config record

universalDomainFields.reason: Forecast contracts start from reusable question templates and output type shape.
universalDomainFields.safeNextAction: define at least one question template before setup intake

universalDomainFields.reason: Forecast close and resolution timing need a declared horizon boundary.
universalDomainFields.safeNextAction: define at least one horizon template before source binding

universalDomainFields.reason: Outcome interpretation must be declared before forecast artifacts can be meaningful.
Every domain needs a baseline fallback before stronger method claims.
universalDomainFields.safeNextAction: bind a baseline method and keep it default until approved evidence exists

universalDomainFields.reason: Source roles define what evidence can be mapped before forecast execution.
universalDomainFields.safeNextAction: define forecast-time, baseline, and resolution roles as needed

universalDomainFields.reason: Unscorable and non-comparable outcomes must be explicit before scoring.
universalDomainFields.safeNextAction: add exclusion rules instead of silently dropping outcomes

universalDomainFields.reason: Calibration and quality claims need domain-specific sample gates.
universalDomainFields.safeNextAction: declare thresholds and keep claims blocked below them

universalDomainFields.reason: Domain configs must not imply quality, calibration, or readiness claims prematurely.
universalDomainFields.safeNextAction: keep claim flags false until checked evidence permits a separate update

universalDomainFields.reason: Domain config readbacks define shape only and do not execute forecasts or private reads.
universalDomainFields.safeNextAction: keep domain config execution boundary non-mutating

universalSourceBindingFields.reason: A source binding must attach to a known domain config and prediction setup.
universalSourceBindingFields.safeNextAction: bind source records by ID instead of by raw file or SQL layout

universalSourceBindingFields.reason: The binding mode tells agents whether the source came from a manifest, adapter, or database manifest.
universalSourceBindingFields.safeNextAction: choose an approved binding mode before field mapping

universalSourceBindingFields.reason: Credential handling must be explicit and reference-only for every source binding.
universalSourceBindingFields.safeNextAction: replace secret values with caller-owned credential references

universalSourceBindingFields.reason: Each accepted source role needs source kind, source reference, adapter reference, and boundary metadata.
universalSourceBindingFields.safeNextAction: map sources to configured role keys through sanitized bindings

universalSourceBindingFields.reason: Mapping, quality, leakage, freshness, privacy, and outcome availability checks gate forecast execution.
universalSourceBindingFields.safeNextAction: run every pre-forecast check before allowing forecast generation

universalSourceBindingFields.reason: Draft, validate, confirm, update, archive, and redact operations stay receipt-backed.
universalSourceBindingFields.safeNextAction: use setup operations instead of raw config mutation

universalSourceBindingFields.reason: Source setup must declare sanitized manifest, mapping, provenance, and query boundaries.
universalSourceBindingFields.safeNextAction: stop unsafe inputs before source intake or method gates

universalSourceBindingFields.reason: Source binding readbacks do not execute APIs, database queries, or forecast creation.
universalSourceBindingFields.safeNextAction: keep source binding execution boundary non-mutating

universalSourceBindingFields.reason: Agents need deterministic routing from accepted, partial, rejected, and blocked bindings.
universalSourceBindingFields.safeNextAction: return an agent-readable next action for every binding case

universalSourceBindingFields.reason: Summary flags give compact checks for approved kinds, blockers, role coverage, and forecast allowance.
universalSourceBindingFields.safeNextAction: keep source binding summary aligned with checks and roles

domainSpecificExtensionFields.reason: Parameter names vary by domain while the template container remains universal.
domainSpecificExtensionFields.safeNextAction: keep parameter names inside question template requiredParameters

domainSpecificExtensionFields.reason: Role names are domain vocabulary but must stay inside universal role containers.
domainSpecificExtensionFields.safeNextAction: define role keys in acceptedSourceRoles and reference them from resolution criteria

domainSpecificExtensionFields.reason: Required source columns differ by domain and source role.
domainSpecificExtensionFields.safeNextAction: declare role-specific fields without adding new top-level source schemas

domainSpecificExtensionFields.reason: Outcome interpretation prose is domain-specific while resolution criteria are universal.
domainSpecificExtensionFields.safeNextAction: write domain-specific criteria inside the resolutionCriteria object

domainSpecificExtensionFields.reason: Domains need their own unscorable and manual-review reason codes.
domainSpecificExtensionFields.safeNextAction: add domain-specific reason codes inside exclusion rules

domainSpecificExtensionFields.reason: Horizon wording varies by operational domain, but each domain still needs horizons.
domainSpecificExtensionFields.safeNextAction: store domain horizon labels and timing descriptions inside horizon templates

domainSpecificExtensionFields.reason: Baseline sample requirements vary by domain but the baseline method object remains universal.
domainSpecificExtensionFields.safeNextAction: set domain-specific thresholds without changing the baseline method container

domainSpecificExtensionFields.reason: Quality thresholds may differ by domain and source role while the check set stays universal.
domainSpecificExtensionFields.safeNextAction: set source quality thresholds inside preForecastChecks

blockedFields.reason: OPE records may reference credentials but must not store secret values.
blockedFields.safeNextAction: replace raw secrets with caller-managed credentialRef values

blockedFields.reason: Database setup uses approved query manifests, not arbitrary raw SQL fields.
blockedFields.safeNextAction: use an approved database adapter manifest with a query boundary

blockedFields.reason: OPE setup records store sanitized manifests and mappings, not raw private rows.
blockedFields.safeNextAction: emit sanitized source-adapter output before source intake

blockedFields.reason: Resolution-only evidence must not become forecast-time evidence.
blockedFields.safeNextAction: mark outcome roles as resolution-only and exclude them before forecast close

blockedFields.reason: New domain configs cannot claim quality or production readiness without scored evidence.
blockedFields.safeNextAction: keep claim boundaries false until a separate evidence gate passes

blockedFields.reason: Domain/source field policy does not promote hosted runtime or listeners.
blockedFields.safeNextAction: use runtime transport readiness before adding hosted or network surfaces

sourceKindFieldRules.notes: Committed fixtures need source and adapter references but no credentials.
Approved local files use sanitized manifests and path boundaries.
Adapter outputs hand OPE sanitized manifests, mappings, and provenance.
Private API bindings require credential references and approved adapter boundaries.
Database bindings require credential references and approved query manifests.

fieldDecisionCases.caseResult: weather transit config carries every universal domain field
fieldDecisionCases.safeNextAction: allow source binding checks to continue

fieldDecisionCases.caseResult: seaport parameters and role fields stay inside extension-safe containers
fieldDecisionCases.safeNextAction: keep candidate setup behind source confirmation

fieldDecisionCases.caseResult: domain config cannot omit outcome interpretation
fieldDecisionCases.safeNextAction: add resolution criteria before source binding or forecast execution

fieldDecisionCases.caseResult: raw credential-like content must be redacted and rejected
fieldDecisionCases.safeNextAction: replace the value with a caller-owned credential reference

fieldDecisionCases.caseResult: raw SQL cannot become an OPE source-binding field
fieldDecisionCases.safeNextAction: use an approved database query manifest boundary

fieldDecisionCases.caseResult: new domain configs must keep quality and production claims false
fieldDecisionCases.safeNextAction: wait for scored evidence and a separate readiness gate

fieldDecisionCases.caseResult: resolution-only roles cannot be forecast-time evidence
fieldDecisionCases.safeNextAction: mark outcome roles resolution-only and rerun leakage checks

readbacks.notes: Prints the checked field policy readback.
Source domain configs for required field containers.
Source binding cases for source field and safety boundaries.
Source quality and mapping confidence remain separate readbacks.
Source intake uses the resulting manifests and mappings.
Runtime security blocks credentials, raw SQL, and private payloads.
Tenant isolation scopes source bindings and credential references.

warnings: This policy classifies fields only; it does not create forecasts or execute private sources.
Domain-specific vocabulary belongs inside approved extension containers, not new top-level records.
Credential values, raw SQL, raw private rows, hosted runtime flags, and premature quality claims are blocked.
